title: Untitled Song
_instructions: 1. Copy this whole stage-template folder and rename the copy (e.g. stages/stage-002).
2. Put your song in the new folder as song.mp3 (or edit the 'audio' field above to match your filename).
3. Open tools/chart-generator.html, pick your MP3, and generate an initial chart.
4. Open tools/chart-editor.html to fine-tune the generated chart (fix timing, swap patterns, adjust density).
5. Export/save chart.json from the editor into your new stage folder, replacing this placeholder.
6. Fill in this stage.json: id, title, artist, bpm (the editor shows the detected bpm), and duration (the song's length in seconds).
7. Register the stage by adding an entry to /stages.json at the project root — that's the ONLY place you need to touch outside this folder; engine/*.js never needs editing to add a song.
